settings.hero_text: Twelve 5x11 pop-up foils with 100 festive sheets in every box. Open one a day from December 13 and reach drawer 12 on Christmas Eve.

settings.intro_text: Get ready to sleigh the season with Framar’s 12 Days of Foils. Wrapped in candy-cane stripes and a pink satin bow, it’s as lovely on your station as it is under the tree. Untie the ribbon, open a numbered drawer each day, and find a little holiday magic inside.
settings.explainer_text: A countdown to Christmas, one little door at a time. Classic calendars run December 1-24. Ours saves the magic for the final twelve days: December 13 to Christmas Eve.

settings.heading: What's Inside?
settings.text: Twelve numbered drawers, one for each day from December 13 to Christmas Eve. Each one holds a surprise foil that’ll leave you feeling merry and bright.
settings.note: Every calendar is packed with its own surprise mix of patterns.

settings.how_text: From your bag to your station: twelve days of holiday magic, one drawer at a time.

settings.title: Order Your Calendar
settings.body: Add Twelve Days of Framar to your bag. It arrives wrapped in candy-cane stripes and a satin bow.

settings.title: Open a Drawer Each Day
settings.body: Starting December 13, count down to Christmas by opening one numbered drawer each day.

settings.title: Enjoy the Magic
settings.body: Discover the foil waiting in each drawer and spread some cheer, one fabulous foil at a time.
